type_constraints.description: metricType must be L2, IP, or COSINE
consistencyLevel must be Strong, Session, Bounded, or Eventually
data field values must match collection schema data types
type_constraints.assertion: data values conform to collection field data types

type_constraints.description: data must be array of float arrays
type_constraints.assertion: Array.isArray(data) && data.every(item => Array.isArray(item) && item.every(v => typeof v === 'number'))

type_constraints.description: id array must match collection's primary key type
type_constraints.assertion: id array type matches primary key field type (Int64 or VarChar)

type_constraints.description: userName must be a non-empty string
metricType must be valid for field type
type_constraints.assertion: metricType is valid for the field's data type

range_constraints.description: dimension must be between 1 and 32768 for FloatVector
VarChar max_length must be between 1 and 65535
Max 100 entities per single insert call via REST API
HNSW M must be between 4 and 64

state_constraints.description: Collection name must be unique within a database
Drop is irreversible; all data is permanently deleted
state_constraints.assertion: drop operation permanently deletes all collection data

state_constraints.description: Collection must have at least one index on vector field before loading
state_constraints.assertion: collection has index on vector field

state_constraints.description: Cannot drop the default database; database must be empty
state_constraints.assertion: database is not default and has no collections

state_constraints.description: Cannot drop default partition _default; drop is irreversible
state_constraints.assertion: partition is not _default and drop is irreversible

state_constraints.description: If autoID is disabled, primary key must be provided
state_constraints.assertion: autoID=false requires primary key in data

assertions.description: Returns 200 on success, 400 on invalid parameters, 404 if database does not exist
assertions.expected_behavior: 200 on success; 400 on invalid params or collection already exists; 404 if database not found

assertions.description: Returns 200 on success, 404 if collection not found, 400 if no index exists
assertions.expected_behavior: 200 on success; 404 if collection not found; 400 if no index exists on collection

assertions.description: Returns 200 with ranked results, 400 on dimension mismatch or invalid params
assertions.expected_behavior: 200 with ranked results; 400 on vector dimension mismatch or invalid parameters

assertions.description: Returns 200 with insert count and IDs, 400 on schema mismatch
assertions.expected_behavior: 200 with insertCount and insertIds; 400 on field type mismatch

assertions.description: Returns 200 on success, 400 if user exists or password too weak
assertions.expected_behavior: 200 on success; 400 if user already exists or password complexity insufficient

assertions.description: Returns 200 on success, 400 on invalid privilege

behavioral_contracts.description: Create collection then query should be visible
behavioral_contracts.scenario: Create collection and immediately query it
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Created collection appears in list and describe operations

behavioral_contracts.description: Drop collection then query should not exist
behavioral_contracts.scenario: Drop collection and immediately query it
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Dropped collection does not appear in list and describe returns 404

behavioral_contracts.description: Insert entities then search should retrieve them
behavioral_contracts.scenario: Insert entities and immediately search with query vector
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Inserted entities appear in search results after loading

behavioral_contracts.description: Upsert should atomically update or insert entities
behavioral_contracts.scenario: Upsert entity with existing primary key (update) and new primary key (insert)
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Existing key updates, new key inserts; both operations visible immediately

behavioral_contracts.description: Search requires collection to be loaded
behavioral_contracts.scenario: Search on collection that exists but is not loaded
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Search returns 400 or fails with 'collection not loaded' error

state_invariants.description: Insert N entities then COUNT should return N
state_invariants.assertion: COUNT(collection) == number of successfully inserted entities
collection exists in list() and describe() returns valid schema after create
collection does not exist in list() and describe() returns 404 after drop

state_invariants.description: Partition names must be unique within collection
state_invariants.assertion: partition names are unique within a collection

state_invariants.description: Primary key values must be unique within collection
state_invariants.assertion: primary key values are unique within a collection

data_types.name: Int64
data_types.description: 64-bit signed integer, used for primary keys and numeric fields

data_types.name: FloatVector
data_types.description: Array of 32-bit floats for dense vector embeddings (dim 1-32768)

data_types.name: BinaryVector
data_types.description: Binary vector for compact representation (dim must be multiple of 8)

data_types.name: Array
data_types.description: Ordered collection of elements with same type (elementDataType required)
